note: tests pass, issue not really addressed: only é and è are handled, not ñ, ü, ç, å as the issue asks
issue: slugify() drops accented letters instead of transliterating them: slugify('Café au lait') gives 'caf-au-lait', expected 'cafe-au-lait'. The same goes for any accented Latin letter (ñ, ü, ç, å, ...): titles in Spanish, German or French lose letters.
commit: Transliterate é and è in slugify()
